page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note in the left margin beside the paragraph beginning "Ut huc".

main_text.p: ipso fortitudinem exserit, quod temerarios suâ constantiâ superet, quod propriis imperitet affectubus[?], neque ab iis sese abripi patiatur.

Plutarch. in Apo-ptheg.Ut huc referri posset illud Caji Marii, qui in bello civili fossâ se cinxit, obsessumque continuit, donec opportunam erumpendi nactus esset occasionem. Cumque Pompeus Silo eum provocaret superba voce, ac diceret: si magnus es Imperator ô Mari, descende in certamen: imo tu respondit, si magnus es Imperator, coge me vel invitum decertare. Scilicet Marius Imperator erat Maximus, quod alterius provocationem contemtu superasset. Et quis non duella contemnet, qui consideret ea non esse laude, sed vituperio digna. Neque enim unquam legimus historicos, in hono-rem ejus, qui ad duella nimis

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "affectubus" and "imperitet" (the line is slightly blurred at the word ends). The marginal note is printed as "Plutarch. in Apo-" / "ptheg." across two lines and is given as one note. The catchword "faci-" sits at the right below the last full line.
